## Result

- Skill: proposal-review
- Review status: approved
- Vision alignment: aligned
- Material findings: none
- Open blockers: none
- Proposal readiness: sufficient direction and embedded feasibility for authorized Design authoring.
- Immediate next stage: isolated stop; Design is the next separately authorized owner.
- Automatic downstream handoff: none.
- Claim limitations: direction approval only. No Design, Delivery, implementation, file deletion, release, publication, final verification or PR readiness is established.

## Review Dimensions

- Challenge: pass. Competing current Release definitions and the risks of premature deletion are concrete maintenance problems, supported by System's candidate map and the two retained Release specifications.
- Goals: pass. Both a usable Release model and actual justified source retirement remain required outcomes; a new file alone cannot complete the initiative.
- Scope: pass. The two principal specifications, their proof intent, ADRs, scoped architecture content and amendments supply a bounded inspection group. Shared remainders and version-specific contracts enter only for necessary standing meaning or a direct dependency. Other model transfers and actual external operations stay separate.
- Governing principle: pass. Precise current ownership, necessary meaning and resolved uses provide a sound rule independent of implementation mechanics.
- Direction: pass. Release's recurring transaction, authority, proof composition, publication evidence and recovery responsibility is distinct from Distribution, Installation, common Skill content and engineering assessment. System's Release candidate supports the selected new owner without requiring the other candidate models.
- Feasibility: pass. Exactly one embedded Feasibility section names a credible existing source basis, minimum package and the remaining dependency/consumer inspection. It makes no current-tooling conformance, safe whole-file deletion or savings claim. Exact source and proof decisions properly remain downstream.
- Material impact: pass. Loss of necessary safety or relied-on historical evidence, mixed retained sources and irreversible external operations are disclosed. Source cleanup and operational release proof remain distinct.
- Vision alignment: pass, aligned. Usable durable authority and preserved necessary rationale support traceable, resumable, reviewable work. Necessary current evidence must remain understandable without reconstructing Git history, satisfying Vision's critical reliance boundary. Redundant source removal does not imply removal of the engineering evidence chain.
- Downstream authority: pass. Design selects exact current clauses, supersessions, retention amendments, consumer interactions and deletion eligibility; Delivery allocates proof. Fresh final whole-change Code Review and distinct Verify remain required. No release or publication authority is inferred.
- Requested decision: pass. Approval is explicitly for the bounded Release-model and source-retirement direction, with its precise limits.

## Scope Preservation Review

- Scope-preservation result: pass. The user's requested Release model and removal of old design documents are visible in Goals, scope, direction, completion and Decision requested. Prior clarification about retaining necessary meaning and proportionate validation remains explicit. Conditional retention protects real remaining uses rather than silently dropping cleanup. Distribution, Installation and remaining validation work retain existing follow-up ownership (System/FU-012 and FU-013); this review does not close them.

## Recommended Proposal Edits

- Recommended edits: none required.

## Recommendation

- Recommendation: approve for Design. Reconcile standing Release requirements and their amendments with substantive displacement mappings before any source is retired. No individual deletion or operational validation exemption has been selected by this review.
- Evidence basis: complete proposal and user request; Constitution and Vision; System's responsibility inventory/candidate map; Design DES-SR-13/21 and scoped retention guidance; release-process requirements covering routine-operation boundaries, permission/proof, public evidence, emergency handling and uncertain-result recovery; transaction requirements covering profile authority, generated/human/historical surfaces, preflight/full verification and public closeout; the two ADR decisions; published-skill-first R7/R8 and scoped amendments; current follow-up ownership. These linked sources were inspected for direction sufficiency, not exhaustively audited for final clause transfer or current implementation conformance. No project-map reliance or code audit was needed for this source-grounded direction decision.
- Important downstream distinction: transaction R45 and older ADR follow-ups contain historical authoring-route instructions. The proposal explicitly requires later-amendment reconciliation and excludes restoring completed rollout/lifecycle procedures; their exact dispositions belong to Design, not a demand to preserve those old procedures unchanged.
- Checks actually run for this review: primary CLI context with full selected activity/review/finding/blocker/applicability; primary subject inspect with full content and exact identities; review record help and targeted recording. No package, runtime, public smoke, publication or historical benchmark was executed or claimed. Record-store structural validation is reported separately after saving.

## Specialized-gate group

- Active gate predicates: scope_budget_context=true; vision_exception_context=false; standing_artifact_context=false.
- Gate outcomes: scope-budget pass. Core Release work, same-slice consumers/retention checks, separate model proposals and excluded publication are explicitly classified. No hidden additional workstream or lost initial goal was found.
- Trigger ambiguity: none.

## Durable-recording group

- Recording status: recorded through review record on successful save.
- Recording blocker: none.
- Record path: docs/changes/2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation/reviews/proposal-review-r1.json
- Finding-record paths: none.

## Formal-review group

- Review ID: proposal-review-r1
- Review record: docs/changes/2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation/reviews/proposal-review-r1.json
- Governed change identity: 2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation
- Invocation classification: formal-lifecycle/manual; PRR1G-recorded-context-gated.
- Independence: separate reviewer agent did not author or edit this proposal; author contribution remains with release-model-proposal-author. Review writes only this judgment/applicability and leaves proposal and activity/work routing unchanged.
independence_basis: Independent reviewer agent did not author or edit the proposal; inspected the complete proposal and required direction basis. Parent authored the reviewed contribution. Separate judgment with no author edits.
